source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, cover page
source.quote: As of November 5, 2026, there were 1,140.1 million shares of the registrant’s Common Stock outstanding.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as SBUX. The FY2026 10-K cover (filed November 12, 2026) is newer than the last 10-Q (quarter ended June 28, 2026); it states the count rounded to 0.1 million (1,140.1 million).
